title: FC Schalke 04 celebrate reaching 200,000 members - Fußball
content: FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V. have reached the 200,000 member mark! The FC Gelsenkirchen-Schalke 04 e.V. supervisory board has agreed to a long-term contract extension with Christina Rühl-Hamers, as announced on Friday (5/9). # FC Schalke 04 celebrate reaching 200,000 members. Susanne from Gelsenkirchen serves as a representative of all the members of the Royal Blue family who have taken steps to express their loyalty and connection to the club in the form of an official membership. “200,000 members is a new level. FC Schalke 04 are known around the globe for having passionate fans who have supported the club week in and week out, across generations and over the decades,” said Matthias Tillmann, CEO of FC Schalke 04, on behalf of the club’s board. This backing is of immense value to FC Schalke 04, and the club extends its heartfelt thanks to every member.”. ### Frank Baumann appointed as FC Schalke 04’s new board member for sport.

title: Bundesliga club-by-club historical guide: FC Schalke 04 | Bundesliga
content: Despite having more opportunities than most, Schalke's fans are still waiting to see the club lift the Bundesliga. # Bundesliga club-by-club historical guide: FC Schalke 04. A total of 58 clubs have had the honour of competing in the Bundesliga since its inception in 1963 – and no team has played in more campaigns without winning the title than Schalke. **bundesliga.com**is taking you through all the teams to have graced Germany’s first division over the last 60+ years. Schalke hold the rather unwanted record of being the club to have played the most seasons in the Bundesliga without ever lifting the Meisterschale. However, silverware has come in the form of five DFB Cups and the 1998 UEFA Cup. They also hold the honour of being the fourth-largest football club in the world by membership, after Bayern, Portugal’s Benfica and regional rivals Borussia Dortmund. ## Club-by-club historical guide: Wolfsburg. ## Club-by-club historical guide: Duisburg. ## Club-by-club historical guide: Heidenheim.
